decisions.hidden_reasoning:
**Analyzing the Matchup**

I'm currently evaluating the optimal play for this crucial matchup. While Gholdengo decisively outspeeds Primarina and can secure a KO, the Dragonite switch is a strategic gamble to preserve Multiscale, albeit risking significant damage from Make It Rain. Ultimately, allowing Primarina to attack first for neutral damage before fainting could soften Gholdengo. I'm weighing the risk/reward of each option.

Earthquake hits Gholdengo super-effectively and will easily OHKO it from 90% HP, while Dragonite is fully protected by Multiscale.

Dragonite is at full HP, so Multiscale likely halves my first hit, and my Sp.Atk is at -2 — Make It Rain won't break it and would drop me further. Dragonite may be a Dragon Dance sweeper, and Sylveon is immune to Dragon moves and bulky enough to pivot in safely. Yawn next turn can force it out or sleep it.
